pages.text: The Auto Collector harvests a crystal farm: it collects mature clusters in range and stores the drops (1-2 Akaishi Essence) in its own 27-slot inventory.$(br2)$(bold)Four tiers$(reset) (range side / time per cluster / energy per tick):$(li)Basic: 3x3x3, 30 ticks, 2 E/t$(li)Medium: 5x5x5, 15 ticks, 4 E/t$(li)Advanced: 9x9x9, 7 ticks, 8 E/t$(li)Ultimate: 16x16x16, 2 ticks, 16 E/t$(br2)When its inventory is full it stops working rather than destroying the clusters.

$(bold)Combination: Catalyst + Collector forms a fully automatic crystal farm.$(reset)$(li)the Catalyst makes Geodes in range produce clusters every tick$(li)the Collector collects the mature clusters and stores the Essence$(br2)With matching ranges the setup runs automatically.$(br2)Hoppers and item pipes can extract the Essence and feed it to a Compressor or other machines.
The $(l:akaishi:catalyst)Catalyst$(/l) supplies the clusters; $(l:akaishi:pulverizer)Pulverizer$(/l) describes where the Essence goes.
